newsitem.title: CANADA: Bombardier gets C$22 mln rail contract.
newsitem.headline: Bombardier gets C$22 mln rail contract.

text.p: Bombardier Inc and Adtranz Sweden said on Thursday that they were awarded a C$31.5 million contract from Stockholm to supply light rail vehicles.

Bombardier's share of the order is about C$22 million. Under the contract, Bombardier and Adtranz will supply 12 light rail vehicles, with an option for a further 58 vehicles, to Stockhoms Lokaltrafik, a mass transit operator.

Deliveries are to begin in spring 1999. The cars will be make by Bombardier-Wien Schienenfahrzeuge (BWS) in Austria and the bogies by BN Division in Belgium, both of which are units of the Bombardier Transportation Group.
The supply of the electrical part, final assembly and vehicle testing and commissioning will be carried out by Adtranz at its Swedish facilities.
The vehicles are articulated, 30 meters long and each car has a capacity of 170 passengers, including 76 seated.
